findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: extract_refund_policy_summary · Private data: verify_merchant_trust, inspect_checkout_url, extract_refund_policy_summary · Public sink: extract_refund_policy_summary.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: extract_refund_policy_summary · Private data: verify_merchant_trust, inspect_checkout_url, extract_refund_policy_summary · Public sink: extract_refund_policy_summary

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
